(rule!
 ;; Each top-row color run encodes a 1-based rank.  For that color, find
 ;; vertical wires whose same-color endpoints enclose a uniform nonzero
 ;; interior of another color.  Sort by interior length descending and recolor
 ;; the ranked wire.  The alternate setting then uses the stage-A result to
 ;; choose the longest selected wire and activate its horizontal 9-filled relay.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define relay-mode "rank_only")
   (define rival "")
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define (run-length c color)
    (let loop ([r 0])
     (if (and (< r h) (= (at g r c) color)) (loop (+ r 1)) r)))
   (define legends
    (for/list ([c (in-range w)] #:when (!= (at g 0 c) 0))
     (list (at g 0 c) (run-length c (at g 0 c)) c)))
   (define (middle-fill color c top bottom)
    (if (< (- bottom top) 2) #f
     (let ([v (at g (+ top 1) c)])
      (and (!= v 0) (!= v color)
       (for/and ([r (in-range (+ top 1) bottom)]) (= (at g r c) v))
       v))))
   (define (record<? a b)
    (or (> (first a) (first b))
        (and (= (first a) (first b))
             (or (< (second a) (second b))
                 (and (= (second a) (second b)) (< (third a) (third b)))))))
   (define (candidates color)
    (sort
     (for*/list ([c (in-range w)] [top (in-range (- h 2))]
                 [bottom (in-range (+ top 2) h)]
                 #:when (= (at g top c) color)
                 #:when (= (at g bottom c) color)
                 #:when (middle-fill color c top bottom))
      (list (- bottom top 1) top c bottom (at g (+ top 1) c)))
     record<?))
   (define (select-record entry)
    (let* ([color (first entry)] [rank (second entry)] [records (candidates color)])
     (and (<= rank (length records)) (list-ref records (- rank 1)))))
   (define selected
    (filter (lambda (p) (second p))
     (for/list ([entry legends]) (list entry (select-record entry)))))
   (define (fill-vertical out pair)
    (let* ([entry (first pair)] [record (second pair)] [color (first entry)]
           [top (second record)] [c (third record)] [bottom (fourth record)])
     (for/fold ([canvas out]) ([r (in-range (+ top 1) bottom)])
      (set-cell canvas r c color))))
   (define stage-a (for/fold ([out g]) ([pair selected]) (fill-vertical out pair)))
   (define (solid-in-stage? color record)
    (let ([top (second record)] [c (third record)] [bottom (fourth record)])
     (for/and ([r (in-range top (+ bottom 1))]) (= (at stage-a r c) color))))
   (define stage-selected
    (filter (lambda (p) (second p))
     (for/list ([entry legends])
      (let ([color (first entry)])
       (list entry (for/first ([record (in-list (candidates color))]
                              #:when (solid-in-stage? color record)) record))))))
   (define raw-longest
    (for/list ([entry legends]) (list entry (first (candidates (first entry))))))
   (define (pick-longest pairs)
    (for/fold ([best #f]) ([pair pairs])
     (if (or (not best) (> (first (second pair)) (first (second best)))) pair best)))
   (define winner
    (if (equal? rival "relay_longest_candidate")
        (pick-longest raw-longest)
        (pick-longest stage-selected)))
   (define (relay-records color)
    (for*/list ([r (in-range h)] [left (in-range (- w 2))]
                [right (in-range (+ left 2) w)]
                #:when (= (at g r left) color)
                #:when (= (at g r right) color)
                #:when (for/and ([c (in-range (+ left 1) right)]) (= (at g r c) 9)))
     (list r left right)))
   (define (fill-relay out record color)
    (for/fold ([canvas out]) ([c (in-range (+ (second record) 1) (third record))])
     (set-cell canvas (first record) c color)))
   (if (and (equal? relay-mode "selected_longest") winner)
       (for/fold ([out stage-a]) ([record (relay-records (first (first winner)))])
        (fill-relay out record (first (first winner))))
       stage-a))))

(rule!
 ;; Each cue is a vertical stack of an endpoint color outside all bars. Its
 ;; height k selects the kth matching bar in outer-to-inner (top-row) order;
 ;; replace that bar's uniform filler with the endpoint color.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define reverse-order? #t)
   (define fixed-rank 0)
   (define recolor-all? #f)
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define (segments c)
    (let loop ([r 0] [out '()])
     (cond
      [(>= r h) (reverse out)]
      [(= (at g r c) bg) (loop (+ r 1) out)]
      [else
       (define end
        (let scan ([e r])
         (if (and (< (+ e 1) h) (not (= (at g (+ e 1) c) bg)))
             (scan (+ e 1)) e)))
       (loop (+ end 1) (cons (list r end) out))])))
   ;; Bar record: column, top, bottom, endpoint color, filler color.
   (define bars
    (apply append
     (for/list ([c (in-range w)])
      (filter-map
       (lambda (seg)
        (define top (first seg))
        (define bottom (second seg))
        (if (< (- bottom top) 2) #f
         (let ([endpoint (at g top c)] [filler (at g (+ top 1) c)])
          (if (and (= (at g bottom c) endpoint)
                   (not (= filler bg)) (not (= filler endpoint))
                   (for/and ([r (in-range (+ top 1) bottom)])
                    (= (at g r c) filler)))
              (list c top bottom endpoint filler) #f))))
       (segments c)))))
   (define colors (sort (remove-duplicates (map fourth bars)) <))
   (define (bar-cell? r c)
    (for/or ([bar (in-list bars)])
     (and (= c (first bar)) (<= (second bar) r) (<= r (third bar)))))
   (define (cue-run c color)
    (let loop ([r 0] [current 0] [best 0])
     (if (= r h) (max current best)
      (if (and (= (at g r c) color) (not (bar-cell? r c)))
          (loop (+ r 1) (+ current 1) best)
          (loop (+ r 1) 0 (max current best))))))
   (define (cue-height color)
    (apply max (for/list ([c (in-range w)]) (cue-run c color))))
   (define (bar<? a b)
    (if (= (second a) (second b))
        (< (first a) (first b))
        (< (second a) (second b))))
   (define (interior bar)
    (for/list ([r (in-range (+ (second bar) 1) (third bar))])
     (list r (first bar))))
   (for/fold ([out g]) ([color (in-list colors)])
    (define group (sort (filter (lambda (bar) (= (fourth bar) color)) bars) bar<?))
    (define ordered (if reverse-order? (reverse group) group))
    (define rank (if (> fixed-rank 0) fixed-rank (cue-height color)))
    (define chosen
     (if recolor-all? ordered
      (if (and (>= rank 1) (<= rank (length ordered)))
          (list (list-ref ordered (- rank 1))) '())))
    (for/fold ([painted out]) ([bar (in-list chosen)])
     (recolor-cells painted (interior bar) color))))))

(rule!
 ;; Each cue is a vertical stack of an endpoint color outside all bars. Its
 ;; height k selects the kth matching bar in outer-to-inner (top-row) order;
 ;; replace that bar's uniform filler with the endpoint color.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define reverse-order? #t)
   (define fixed-rank 0)
   (define recolor-all? #f)
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define (segments c)
    (let loop ([r 0] [out '()])
     (cond
      [(>= r h) (reverse out)]
      [(= (at g r c) bg) (loop (+ r 1) out)]
      [else
       (define end
        (let scan ([e r])
         (if (and (< (+ e 1) h) (not (= (at g (+ e 1) c) bg)))
             (scan (+ e 1)) e)))
       (loop (+ end 1) (cons (list r end) out))])))
   ;; Bar record: column, top, bottom, endpoint color, filler color.
   (define bars
    (apply append
     (for/list ([c (in-range w)])
      (filter-map
       (lambda (seg)
        (define top (first seg))
        (define bottom (second seg))
        (if (< (- bottom top) 2) #f
         (let ([endpoint (at g top c)] [filler (at g (+ top 1) c)])
          (if (and (= (at g bottom c) endpoint)
                   (not (= filler bg)) (not (= filler endpoint))
                   (for/and ([r (in-range (+ top 1) bottom)])
                    (= (at g r c) filler)))
              (list c top bottom endpoint filler) #f))))
       (segments c)))))
   (define colors (sort (remove-duplicates (map fourth bars)) <))
   (define (bar-cell? r c)
    (for/or ([bar (in-list bars)])
     (and (= c (first bar)) (<= (second bar) r) (<= r (third bar)))))
   (define (cue-run c color)
    (let loop ([r 0] [current 0] [best 0])
     (if (= r h) (max current best)
      (if (and (= (at g r c) color) (not (bar-cell? r c)))
          (loop (+ r 1) (+ current 1) best)
          (loop (+ r 1) 0 (max current best))))))
   (define (cue-height color)
    (apply max (for/list ([c (in-range w)]) (cue-run c color))))
   (define (bar<? a b)
    (if (= (second a) (second b))
        (< (first a) (first b))
        (< (second a) (second b))))
   (define (interior bar)
    (for/list ([r (in-range (+ (second bar) 1) (third bar))])
     (list r (first bar))))
   (for/fold ([out g]) ([color (in-list colors)])
    (define group (sort (filter (lambda (bar) (= (fourth bar) color)) bars) bar<?))
    (define ordered (if reverse-order? (reverse group) group))
    (define rank (if (> fixed-rank 0) fixed-rank (cue-height color)))
    (define chosen
     (if recolor-all? ordered
      (if (and (>= rank 1) (<= rank (length ordered)))
          (list (list-ref ordered (- rank 1))) '())))
    (for/fold ([painted out]) ([bar (in-list chosen)])
     (recolor-cells painted (interior bar) color))))))
